cases.proves_bugs: BUG-657 (Edit Pipe route: one of the pipe's two level texts on a locked layer, so neither is written and the pipe is named)
cases.title: With the end level text of P82 -> P83 on a locked layer, Recalculate downstream from an Edit Pipe on P81 -> P82 changes neither of that pipe's level texts and names the pipe as not updated
cases.plan_item: Bug-proof plan wave 1 (BUG_PROOF_PLAN_31OCT.md), group E: the cascade and a locked level-text layer
cases.expected: Three pits P81, P82, P83 and pipes P81->P82 (18.300 / 18.200) and P82->P83 (18.150 / 18.050), no Grade mismatch window. The text 'IL 18.050' moves to layer E3LOCK and E3LOCK is locked. Edit Pipe on P81->P82 with 18.40 / 18.30, Save, Recalculate Yes, Cascade Preview Apply: the command line says 'Nothing was changed - no pipe could be updated (P82 -> P83). The levels on the drawing and in the schedule are as they were.' and no 'Updated' line; the CE log says the invert text 'could not be updated to 18.15'. The P82->P83 texts still read IL 18.150 and IL 18.050 (the locked one still on E3LOCK); no text reads IL 18.25. E3LOCK is unlocked again at the end. No CE window is left open; the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: IlTextWriteGateTests prove the all-or-nothing rule with stand-ins; only a live drawing has AutoCAD's real locked-layer refusal on a real CE level text inside the real cascade.
not_automated: The other order (the START text locked, the end text open) is not driven: before the fix both orders wrote the open text, after it neither; one order is enough to see the difference. CDPROPAGATE is not driven.
The pipe's stored record (18.150 / 18.050) and the Pit Schedule are not read; that 'the record was left as it was' rests on the CE line and log.

DERIVED, not yet seen on a run: every line and level above; that CHPROP of a CE level text to another layer is left there by CE (checked below: its layer is read back); that the robot's typed -LAYER _NEW makes the layer (the _LOCK / _UNLOCK forms are R33's).

cases.title: A pit label erased on its own no longer breaks CE: after a U the link memory rebuilds, and PITDELETE on that pit deletes it cleanly
cases.plan_item: BUG-proof wave 1, group P (ERASE and OOPS); BUG-667
cases.expected: PIT at 150000,-80000 (cover 19.000, Esc at the label question places the number label at the usual spot). Pick only the label and type ERASE: the pit stays, the label goes. Draw a short LINE and type U (echo word LINE). Zoom to the pit and type PITDELETE, picking the pit's north wall at 150000,-79675: the command line says 'Pit deleted (block + label/cover).', never '[CE] Error during PITDELETE - see CE log for details.', and nothing of the new pit is left. The Civil log gets no [ERR] line during the case.
cases.why_not_unit: The fault needs a real erased object still named on a real pit's list inside AutoCAD's database (opening an erased object throws only in AutoCAD), then a live U and a live PITDELETE.
not_automated: The other symptoms in the bug (a pipe MOVE no longer carrying its labels, schedule rows left dangling) are not driven: the U rebuild is exercised and the CE log is checked for an error line, which is where the stopped rebuild would show.

cases.expected: ROTATE Copy of P3 by 90 degrees about 58777.7,-25569.9 shows "1 pit copied and numbered as new." and adds one pit block at 58777.7,-30569.9 (within 1 mm), one PIT LABEL block reading P8 and one cover text (CL ...). Not driven: grip Ctrl-drag copy (needs a mouse drag; it also stays with the older tick), PITDELETE on a copy, the copy's own Pit Schedule row (the schedule is not read), and the look of the scaled pit block (Codex look).

cases.proves_bugs: BUG-665 pipe half only (a ROTATE Copy of a pipe is numbered as new and gets its own label, level texts and arrow)
cases.title: ROTATE Copy of a CE pipe (shipped switch ON) gives a new pipe of its own: CE says it was numbered as new and draws its own label, IL 18.000 and IL 17.800 texts and flow arrow
cases.plan_item: BUG-665 pipe half (ROTATE Copy of a pipe); SCALE Copy of a pipe, grip Ctrl-drag and the 'conflicting label move' symptom not driven
cases.expected: After SETUP-R47v, ROTATE Copy by 180 degrees about 160000,-72500 of the new pipe alone shows "1 pipe copied and numbered as new." and adds exactly one new CE pipe object, one pipe label (text containing " DIA. "), one "IL 18.000" text within 1000 mm of 169775,-65000, one "IL 17.800" text within 1000 mm of 150000,-65000, and one flow arrow block. No CE window is left open. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The clean-up runs when AutoCAD ends its own ROTATE command on the live drawing, and the switch is read from the real settings file when AutoCAD starts.
not_automated: DERIVED, not yet seen on a run: that the copy's level texts read "IL 18.000" and "IL 17.800" (the regenerated texts come from the copied record, CloneRegeneration.cs 161-185; R03 reads the same words on the original); the 1000 mm radius (select near=) allows R03's 800 mm plus the 225 mm wall move; the arrow is matched by a block name containing ARROW (as R32). The distances use select near= on purpose: the dist step throws on an empty list, which would end the twin on a step instead of a check.

Not driven: that a later MOVE of the original's label is no longer refused as 'conflicting' (the symptom in BUG-665's text), the copy's own Pipe Schedule row, SCALE Copy of a pipe (it would change the pipe's length and so its grade), grip Ctrl-drag. The look of the copy is a Codex look.
